svg.text: 555 clock + decade counter = a light running along the centimetre marks
LEDs at every cm (10 cm) / 1.5 cm (15 cm)
f = 1.44 / ((R1 + 2 x (R2 + RV1)) x C1) = about 1.4 to 12 steps per second
TLC555 (CMOS) and 74HC4017 run from a 3 V coin cell. A normal NE555 needs about 4.5 V.
Only one LED is on at a time, so all cathodes share R3.
CD4017 also fits (same pinout), with dimmer LEDs at 3 V.
Blue / white / pure green LEDs need more than 3 V: use them only with a 5 V supply.
